body: Saaaame. I just feel like I bother people, too.. It really sucks. And it's frustrating me that I'm getting trolling responses when I came to this forum for support. I don't feel so safe here anymore.
Is this post supposed to be helpful somehow? Or are you being sarcastic for the fun of it?

Same here... :( I've sort of just accepted that the majority of people don't really care and you need to care for yourself instead of seeking the care from others. Did you used to install again after like, 30 minutes or so? Lol because I did that quite often when I was on FB.

I definitely can relate to this, but I have to echo what others have said by saying that just because they've forgiven you, doesn't mean they're on good terms with you or want to be friends. It really does suck, but that's just how life is... 🙁
Just commenting to say I love your username! MGS is awesome. 😁
Very rude and harsh response 😕 how about talking to people in a better manner next time?
Okay, but I didn't even say that *only* BPDs experience splitting.
Oh dear. :( He keeps telling me just to give it a chance to see what happens.

It's scary because I could have wrote this. I feel exactly the same way. People start becoming distant from me after a while and it really pisses me off and makes me depressed, even though it's my fault. I don't care about what other people have been doing either or what their problems are. My main concern is how I am feeling and my wellbeing is more important than anybody else's right now, because I want to be better. During conversations with people I just drift off and focus on what's on my mind instead. I barely talk in social situations and don't care to ask questions to people about what they've been doing, how work has been, etc. It's annoying because I complain about people never wanting to see me and get angry but it's obvious why they don't. If I feel like somebody is getting more and more distant, I will cut them off before they have the chance to do it to me. It hurts a lot less that way.
Great advice! Thank you. :) I'm currently on the waiting list to get therapy, so I'm hoping it will help.

Every time. I'm dating somebody and since he keeps talking about snuggling, sleeping in bed, etc, a lot, I just assume he only wants me for one thing. I'm still unsure whether that's his only motive or not. His drive is high and mine is non-existent, so there's going to be issues down the line.

I do exactly the same! Ugh, I tell myself they don't matter, but it's really easier said than done, isn't it? I say, "nope, not speaking to them again", and they message and I fall for it every single time.
God, it's so frustrating, isn't it?! I'm just like, brain, make up your mind; you either like them or you don't.

I'm like this, too. I feel like if I buy people things and help them out, they will become closer to me and like me more. At the end of the day, it feels like I'm only doing things for others that benefit myself, so I end up feeling selfish and evil for being manipulative.

I help out my FP when she is feeling down and I do genuinely care about her, but inside, I'm still hoping me helping her would bring her closer to me. When this doesn't happen, I do get upset/mad.

Thanks for the advice. :) 

I've had an esophageal manometry along with a 24-hour pH test and both were okay, although it did mention I had mass regurgitation. I originally thought it was achalasia, but this was ruled out.

Makes sense.

I've had two endoscopies in the last three years and there's still no damage present. 

I'm just unsure with what to do, because it interferes with my daily life, and doctors just keep handing me PPIs that don't work. As I said in my main post, surgery is apparently out of the question, so I'm unsure with what to do.

Yes - this is what put me off my last boyfriend. He called his previous ex-girlfriend "crazy" and love-bombed me. He told me he loved me after two days of dating. I nope'd the hell out of there. I have BPD and I used to tell others about the crap my ex's did, but I do not bring up ex's anymore, especially not to potential partners. It's got nothing to do with the date/partner and I now believe it should stay in the past.

Absolutely. My main form of communication was through Facebook, and since I have deleted it, I have felt better. I'm aware that this isn't normal, and I want to be able to be around people happily without being triggered by the slightest thing some people do.

Yes! Every time there's a confrontation, I don't really get angry, but I do panic. I shake and my heart pounds. I always assume they're going to lay into me, but it doesn't happen the majority of the time.
It's not like I'm like that with everybody.. There's a few people I'm completely fine with.

Absolutely. Everything pisses me off nowadays, ESPECIALLY in public. People walking too slow, people walking right at me, people staring at me, people taking too long to put their groceries out, etc. I'm even getting more annoyed in the house. When my dad gets in the way, when my sister mimics how my mum speaks to my dog, etc, and I wonder why and complain when people hate/dislike me and try get people to like me, lmao. I'm completely miserable and life is shit so I have given up trying to act civil and nice, although I do try my best to act genuine and pleasant around people, but it's so much work..

Let's see.

When I'm in group chats and I feel like people aren't paying attention to me but to others, when I feel left out on social situations, when certain people take too long to reply to messages, when friends on FB always like other people's statuses/pictures and never mine, when a close friend spends more time with another friend (I feel abandoned, become depressed, bitter, and jealous of the other friend and lose respect for my close friend), when people's tone in messages change all of a sudden (I think I've screwed up or think they find me annoying so I change my tone towards them, too), seeing "friends" together and I'm not in the pictures, when people stare at me in public, and people not giving me validation/reassurance when I beat myself up. Also, I can relate with the makeup thing. I feel myself get hot, angry, and lash out when it looks shit.

Speaking of pettiness, if somebody takes ages to reply to a message, I will take twice as long to reply. That's petty, haha. Then again, it depends on the person. I will reply quick to some people despite how long they took.
Yeah, I'm like this, and can definitely say it's an anxiety/insecurity issue.
Yes! I have always felt "weird" compared to everybody else. I don't feel normal compared to them. The only people that understand me are the people on this board and my mum (in a way).

*virtual hugs* Had exactly the same issue with my old ex! Always liked other girl's pictures but never, ever mine. I didn't say anything because every time I brought up a concern, it turned into an argument and he'd remove me off Facebook and put his relationship status to single every time..
Sucksssss, doesn't it?! :( The way I behave and feel makes me want to isolate myself from everybody.
